[[File:Piergiulio Nardulli DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Piergiulio Nardulli at [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Piergiulio Nardulli''' was the Chandrila Regional qualifier at the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], from Bari, Puglia, Italy.<ref name="field">[https://web.archive.org/web/19991128125001/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/finalists.html Finalists], Decipher (Wayback 28 November 1999)</ref>
